8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8"""
G = [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in rows.split('\n')]
assert len(G)==26 and len(G[0])==22

# find connected zero regions
from collections import deque
seen = [[False]*22 for _ in range(26)]
regions = []
for r in range(26):
    for c in range(22):
        if G[r][c]==0 and not seen[r][c]:
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<26 and 0<=nb<22 and not seen[na][nb] and G[na][nb]==0:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
            rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
            regions.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
print(regions)

# pattern = non-zero cells bounding box, per region
out=[row[:] for row in G]
for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
    nz=[(r,c,G[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if G[r][c] not in (0,8)]
    color=nz[0][2]
    pr0=min(x[0] for x in nz); pc0=min(x[1] for x in nz)
    pr1=max(x[0] for x in nz); pc1=max(x[1] for x in nz)
    P=[[G[r][c] for c in range(pc0,pc1+1)] for r in range(pr0,pr1+1)]
    ph,pw=len(P),len(P[0])
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[r][c]=P[(r-pr0)%ph][(c-pc0)%pw]
for row in out: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
